versions.content: If UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and the UdpNm module has stored PNC IDs as pending request for a synchronized PNC shutdown, then the UdpNm shall remove those PNC IDs from storage which are either externally or internally requested a gain:  UdpNm shall check on reception of an NM - message, if externally requested PNCs are received  UdpNm shall check up front to each transmission of an PN shutdown message if internal PNC requests are available by deriving the internal PNC requests from the corresponding ComPdu (see UdpNmTxUserDataPduRef )
